# Bagisto GraphQL to Ventari contract mapping

**Status:** PROPOSAL.
**Machine-readable source of truth:** [`VENTARI_BAGISTO_TO_VENTARI_API_MAPPING.csv`](VENTARI_BAGISTO_TO_VENTARI_API_MAPPING.csv), 105 rows, generated by `python3 docs/ventari/tools/build_api_mapping.py` from [`audit/graphql_operations.csv`](audit/graphql_operations.csv). The script fails if any operation is unmapped. **Current result: 105 mapped, 0 unmapped.**

Totals: **REPLACE 70 · REMOVE 23 · DEFER 9 · ADAPT 3 · KEEP 0**. No Bagisto GraphQL operation survives. Bagisto is not deployed for Ventari.

## 1. Endpoint families

| Family | Base | Exists today? | Owner job |
|---|---|---|---|
| Catalog BFF v2 | `/api/ventari/v2/` — `search`, `suggest`, `categories`, `category`, `products/{slug}`, `availability`, `lookup`, `similar` | **Yes** (`server/api/ventari/v2/*`, integration `3ce4c2a`) | OpenAPI: VJ-131 |
| Delivery promise | `/api/ventari/v2/delivery-promise` | No | VJ-118 |
| Mobile commerce BFF v1 | `/api/ventari/m/v1/` — `session/*`, `cart/*`, `checkout/*`, `orders/*`, `returns/*`, `account/*`, `saved-items/*`, `support/*`, `push/*`, `config` | No | contract VJ-132, implementation VJ-170, payment VJ-152, push VJ-155, config VJ-160 |
| Plugin Store API (server-side only) | `/store-api/ventari/external-line-item`, `promotion`, `saved-items` (+ new `order/{id}/cancel`, order lookup) | Partly | VJ-117, VJ-135, VJ-136 |

Every mutation carries `Idempotency-Key`. Every money field is `{amountCents:int, currency:"USD"}` or an integer `*Cents` field. The client never sends a price.

## 3. Field-level contracts that change behaviour

| Concern | Bagisto field(s) | Ventari field(s) | Behaviour change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Price | `price`, `formattedPrice`, `specialPrice`, client `discountPercent` | `priceCents`, `listPriceCents`, `discount{amountCents, percentOff}` | No client discount math; compare-at shown only when present (claims policy C-x) |
| Line total / cart totals | client price × qty; minimum-order arithmetic | server `cart.lines[].totalCents`, `cart.totals.*Cents` (VJ-132) | Client sums nothing; minimum order is a server notice |
| Stock | `isSaleable`, `qty`, missing = in stock | `variants[].sellable`, `availability.status`, `maxOrderQuantity` | `unknown` is not purchasable |
| Product identity | `id`, `urlKey` | `slug` (canonical), `id`, `entityId`, `contentVersion` | Alias slug → redirect outcome; cache keyed by `contentVersion` |
| Media | Bagisto image URLs | `media[]{url, alt, width, height, isPrimary}` (rights-gated by VJ-119) | HTTPS only; alt text required |
| Ratings | `averageRating`, `reviews` | `rating{average, count}` or `null` | `null` = no stars shown |
| Cart session | `bagisto_guest_cart_token` (SharedPreferences) | opaque session token (Keychain/Keystore) | Server-side mapping to Shopware context |
| Order placement | `createCheckoutOrder` | `POST m/v1/checkout/order` + `Idempotency-Key` | Retry returns the same order |
| Payment | `createCheckoutPaymentMethod`; `paymentGatewayUrl` unused | `payment-session` from the order total; PSP sheet | Success only after server confirmation |

## 4. Order of migration (each step shippable to internal testers)

1. Catalog read path (search, categories, PDP, suggest). The client in `lib/ventari` already exists. Point it at the BFF behind a per-feature flag (VJ-171).
2. Session (guest, login, logout) in secure storage.
3. Cart.
4. Checkout and payment.
5. Account, orders and saved items.
6. Cancellation and returns.
7. Push and deep links.
8. Delete the Bagisto `core/graphql` layer and its tests. The guardrail test then extends to the whole `lib/`.
